caption:
Your front desk isn't the problem.

Most owners blame whoever picked up the phone when a lead goes cold.

Ask three people on your team what happens the moment a new lead calls in. You'll get three different answers most of the time.

That gap is a missing system for the single most valuable moment in your business.

A real system runs the same sequence every time, regardless of who answers or what day it is. That's infrastructure.

DM SCALE and Black Arrow builds that pipeline for your shop.
